content: .{@-वंशः@} (प्राग्वंशः) .²1 a kind of sacrificial room having its columns turned towards the east; श्लाघ्यस्त्यागोऽपि वैदेह्याः पत्युः प्राग्वंशवासिनः <ls>R. 15. 61</ls>. (प्राचीनस्थूणो यज्ञशालाविशेषः <ls>Malli.</ls>; but some interpret the word to mean ‘a room in which the friends and family of the sacrificer assemble’); केचिद् बभञ्जुः प्राग्वंशं पलीशालं तथाऽपरे <ls>Bhāg. 4. 5. 14</ls>. .²2 a former dynasty or generation.
